What happened inside the Glass Columns ''was the absolute truth of the time when it was shown''. This being said, the Aiel ''would have been'' wiped out unless they were integrated in the Dragon's Peace; if not, Padra, Aviendha's daughter, and later on Oncala, Padra's daughter, would have initiated the war against the Seanchan, eventually leading to their destruction. As they are now integrated in the treaty, and perhaps more importantly so the Seanchan, this future will not come true. A pity we never learned what Bair saw when she went to Rhuidean a third time.
